comments.author: Charles Maddock
comments.text:
Hi everyone! Charles here, and I'm really excited to share Strawberry 1.0 with you 🍓  
  
A year ago we launched our beta here on Product Hunt. Back then, Strawberry was a simple browser with a built-in AI agent.  
  
Today it's a fully fledged agent platform that hundreds of teams, including Lovable, Tandem Health and ElevenLabs, use to run agents around the clock, transcribe meetings and build a shared company context.  
  
We call these agents "companions".  
  
🫠 **The problem**  
  
Developers already have great AI agents that can work for hours on end, like Claude Code and Codex. But those tools are built for people who work in files, not tabs. These apps are powerful, but usually too complex for the average non-technical team.  
  
Newer assistants like Dots, Grok Bot and Instinct are much more delightful and intuitive, and they're great for consumers. But they're hard to rely on for real team work. You mostly work through one long chat and can't easily see what the agent is doing.  
  
🌐 **Why we built a browser**  
  
The browser strikes the perfect balance between intuitive and powerful.  
  
Everyone knows how to use a browser, and it's where most of your team's work already happens. Your tools, your context and your logins are all there. The browser as the interface makes it much easier for e.g. sales, marketing and talent teams to get started with agents, while still being possible to build advanced systems that run on their own.  
  
We're also big believers in the agentic web. Soon there will be trillions of AI agents communicating and trading with each other. With Strawberry, you are ready for that future, while your companions can still leverage today's internet.  
  
🧩 **What you get**  
  
• You can start with an official companion, like Sales Sally for sales or Talent Theo for recruiting, or create your own in a few minutes. Your companion interviews you and learns how you work.  
• You can see and edit everything your companion knows and does: its skills, routines and memory.  
• Big jobs run in parallel. Ask it to research 200 accounts and you get one finished sheet back.  
• When a companion works well, share it, and your whole team can use it.  
• Use any AI model you like. We're SOC 2 Type II compliant with EU data residency, and your companion always asks before it sends anything.  
  
🎁 **For the Product Hunt community:** get 50% off your first month on any monthly plan with code PH50, until 8 November.  
  
🚀 **Try it** for free at strawberrybrowser.com, on Mac and Windows.  
  
What's the first job you'd give your companion? Our whole team is in the comments all day, and we'll share the wackiest answers in our team chat 👀

comments.kr:
여러분 안녕하세요! Charles입니다. Strawberry 1.0을 여러분께 선보이게 되어 정말 기쁩니다 🍓

1년 전 저희는 Product Hunt에서 베타 버전을 출시했습니다. 당시 Strawberry는 내장형 AI 에이전트가 탑재된 단순한 브라우저였습니다.

오늘날 Strawberry는 Lovable, Tandem Health, ElevenLabs를 포함한 수백 개의 팀이 24시간 내내 에이전트를 구동하고, 회의를 전사 기록하며, 공유된 회사 컨텍스트를 구축하는 본격적인 에이전트 플랫폼으로 성장했습니다.

저희는 이 에이전트들을 "컴패니언(Companions)"이라고 부릅니다.

🫠 **문제점**

개발자들에게는 이미 Claude Code나 Codex처럼 몇 시간이고 쉬지 않고 일할 수 있는 훌륭한 AI 에이전트가 있습니다. 하지만 그러한 도구들은 탭(tabs)이 아닌 파일(files)을 다루는 사람들을 위해 만들어졌습니다. 강력하긴 하지만, 기술적 배경이 없는 일반 팀에게는 지나치게 복잡합니다.

Dots, Grok Bot, Instinct와 같은 최신 어시스턴트들은 훨씬 유쾌하고 직관적이며 일반 소비자에게 훌륭합니다. 하지만 실제 팀 업무에서 신뢰하기는 어렵습니다. 주로 하나의 긴 채팅을 통해 작업하게 되며 에이전트가 내부에서 무엇을 하고 있는지 쉽게 확인하기 어렵기 때문입니다.

🌐 **브라우저를 만든 이유**

브라우저는 직관성과 강력함 사이에서 완벽한 균형을 이룹니다.

누구나 브라우저 사용법을 알고 있으며, 팀의 대부분의 작업이 이미 브라우저에서 이루어집니다. 여러분의 도구, 컨텍스트, 로그인 정보가 모두 그곳에 있습니다. 브라우저를 인터페이스로 활용하면 영업, 마케팅, 채용 팀 등이 에이전트를 훨씬 쉽게 시작할 수 있으면서도, 스스로 실행되는 고급 시스템을 구축하는 것 또한 가능합니다.

저희는 '에이전틱 웹(Agentic Web)'의 가능성 또한 굳게 믿고 있습니다. 머지않아 수조 개의 AI 에이전트가 서로 소통하고 거래하게 될 것입니다. Strawberry와 함께라면 오늘날의 인터넷을 컴패니언이 그대로 활용하면서도 그 미래를 대비할 수 있습니다.

🧩 **제공 기능**

• 영업을 위한 'Sales Sally'나 채용을 위한 'Talent Theo'와 같은 공식 컴패니언으로 시작하거나, 몇 분 만에 직접 맞춤형 컴패니언을 만들 수 있습니다. 컴패니언이 사용자를 인터뷰하며 업무 방식을 학습합니다.
• 컴패니언이 알고 있는 지식과 행동(스킬, 루틴, 메모리)을 모두 확인하고 편집할 수 있습니다.
• 대규모 작업은 병렬로 실행됩니다. 200개의 계정을 조사하도록 요청하면 완성된 시트 하나로 받아볼 수 있습니다.
• 컴패니언이 효과적으로 작동하면 이를 공유하여 팀 전체가 함께 사용할 수 있습니다.
• 원하는 어떤 AI 모델이든 사용 가능합니다. SOC 2 Type II 인증 및 EU 데이터 보관 규정을 준수하며, 컴패니언은 무언가를 외부로 전송하기 전에 항상 사용자에게 확인을 요청합니다.

🎁 **Product Hunt 커뮤니티 혜택:** 11월 8일까지 할인 코드 PH50을 입력하시면 모든 월간 플랜의 첫 달 요금을 50% 할인해 드립니다.

🚀 Mac과 Windows에서 strawberrybrowser.com을 통해 무료로 **체험해 보세요**.

comments.author: ZHANG YICHI
comments.text:
Hey Product Hunt 👋

I'm Yichi, the maker behind _SurgePix_.

**_SurgePix puts the whole job in one place — no juggling a dozen tools. Its built-in design agent can even search the live web and design straight from what it finds._**

It started with a simple frustration: every AI image tool I tried was great at generating something new, but the moment I wanted to **_tweak a color_**, **_swap a headline_**, or **_keep things on-brand across a whole set of visuals_**, I was stuck starting over.

The latest models — _GPT Image 2.5_ and friends — are genuinely amazing at generating that first image, or that first slide.

The problem starts after: I'd generate a whole deck in one click, then spend an hour fixing headlines, swapping charts, and getting every slide back on-brand. **_That redo-from-scratch gap is exactly what SurgePix is built to close — for decks, and for every visual you make_**.

So we built SurgePix around three ideas:

*   **_Edit, don't regenerate_**: brush over any area to repaint it, split a flat image into editable layers, or pull the text off an image to retype it
    
*   Upload your brand assets once, and every output stays on-brand
    
*   For developers: **_SurgePix ships as open-source agent skills_**, so Claude Code, Cursor, or any AI agent can generate and edit visuals for you — _right from your terminal, no browser needed_
    

We're still early and shipping fast. Would love to hear what you think, and what you'd want SurgePix to do next.

_👉_**_Try it free:_** [**_https://surgepix.ai_**](https://surgepix.ai/?utm_source=producthunt&utm_medium=maker_comment&utm_campaign=ph_launch_2026)

**MiniMax M3.1 Flash** is MiniMax’s next-generation Flash model, built for agentic tasks, coding, computer use and cybersecurity. MiniMax calls it a “generational leap” over its predecessor.

An early version ran anonymously as “Space Bunny”, and MiniMax says it processed over 200 trillion tokens before the official launch.

**What’s new in M3.1 Flash:**

*   About 3x faster online inference than its predecessor, with more aggressive sparsity improving inference efficiency
    
*   A 70% lower usage cost for agentic tasks
    
*   Output at 200+ tokens per second in everyday use, with a median of 170+
    
*   Stronger agentic, coding, computer use and cybersecurity performance
    

**Some numbers:**

*   DeepSWE v1.1: 73.7%
    
*   OSWorld V2: 61.7 and ALE: 29.6, which MiniMax says rank first among Chinese models
    
*   BankerToolBench: 76.2
    
*   CyberGym: 82%, assessed by MiniMax’s internal security experts
    

Pricing is flat at $0.15 per 1M input tokens, $0.60 per 1M output tokens and $0.015 per 1M cached input tokens.

You can use it through the MiniMax API, the M Plan subscription and the MiniMax Code desktop app. Good fit if you’re building coding or computer-use agents and want a fast, low-cost model.

Hey Product Hunt 👋 Ross ([@ross\_jenkins](https://www.producthunt.com/@ross_jenkins)) & Dani ([@dani\_martin1](https://www.producthunt.com/@dani_martin1)), the owners of N8N Chat UI.  
  
**The problem**  
n8n is brilliant for building AI agents, but its built-in chat widget is basic. Making it look like your brand means digging into HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and your webhook URL sits in the page source for anyone to find.  
  
**What we built**  
A visual builder that turns any n8n workflow into a polished, on-brand chat widget. Customize it with a live preview, copy one snippet, and it's on your site. No code.  
Try the builder yourself, no signup needed: [n8nchatui.com](https://n8nchatui.com/#widget-config-section)  
  
**Key features**  

*   Popup or in-page widgets, fully themed: colors, fonts, avatars, welcome messages, custom CSS
    

  

*   Streaming replies, voice input, file uploads, follow-up prompts, Markdown/HTML rendering
    

  

*   RTL support for Arabic, Hebrew and Persian
    

  

*   Managed widgets: hidden webhook, domain restrictions, geofencing, rate limits and real-time analytics
    

  

*   MCP server: ask Claude, Cursor or VS Code to create and restyle widgets for you
    

  

*   Official plugins for WordPress, Webflow, Shopify and Wix, plus an n8n community node
    

  
  
**For developers: it's no-code, but not locked down**  

*   Send messages programmatically with sendMessage(): start a chat from a "Ask about this product" button, a form submission, a URL parameter, or after a visitor has been idle on the checkout page
    

  

*   Event callbacks (onWidgetOpen, beforeSubmit, onResponseReceived, onError…) to hook the chat into your analytics or app logic
    

  

*   Pass custom metadata (user ID, plan, current page) to your n8n workflow with every message
    

  

*   Change the theme and starter prompts on the fly with updateTheme() and updatePrompts(), no reload needed
    

  

*   Session keys to keep separate conversations per page or per user
    

  

*   Works with any backend that returns JSON, not only n8n
    

  
  
**For agencies**  

*   Build a branded chat widget for every client in minutes, and clone widgets to reuse your best setups
    

  

*   Help your clients turn more website visitors into leads and sales
    

  

*   Show clients the results in the analytics panel, with message counts you can use to charge them per message
    

  
  
**How pricing works**  
One paid plan: a lifetime license. Pay once, never pay again. You can also try it free with 100 credits, no card needed.  
  
**How it started**  
N8N Chat UI launched on the n8n community forum in April 2025 to fix a problem every n8n builder runs into: you build a great AI agent, put it on your website, and get a generic chat window with hardly any options to match your brand, unless you write the code yourself.  
  
It caught on. More than 2,700 people have built widgets with it, and a lot of what shipped along the way began as requests from the community: session management, a free way to get started, streaming replies, voice notes and file uploads.  
  
**Why we bought it**  
In August 2026, we bought N8N Chat UI from its original creator, and Nicholas and Daniel from Ross's team at DigitalME joined us to build it out. We could see how many people already relied on it, because it fixes what n8n's own chat widget can't. And we could see how much further it could go: more advanced features, and a library of ready-made n8n recipes we're building to give to the community for free.  
  
Our first big step is getting it onto the platforms people actually build with: official plugins for WordPress, Wix, Webflow and Shopify, plus an n8n community node that replaces the usual webhook wiring.

[@ross\_jenkins](https://www.producthunt.com/@ross_jenkins)  [@jonnotie](https://www.producthunt.com/@jonnotie)  [@vipul\_kumar1280](https://www.producthunt.com/@vipul_kumar1280) That's exactly what Managed widgets are for. The visitor's browser never sees your n8n webhook URL.

How it works:

*   **The browser only talks to us.** Your embed code points to our proxy ([proxy.n8nchatui.com/api/chat/your-widget](http://proxy.n8nchatui.com/api/chat/your-widget)). Your real webhook URL is stored encrypted on our side and isn't included in anything we send to the page.
    
*   **We forward each message to n8n from our server.** If you turn on authentication on your n8n webhook (Basic Auth, Header Auth or JWT), we add those credentials on the way through. They never reach the browser either, and your webhook rejects anything that doesn't come through us.

Windows와 macOS 모두에서 독립형(Standalone) 앱 및 DAW 플러그인(VST/AU) 형태로 무료 다운로드하여 사용할 수 있습니다.
products.comment_summary: Scrap Brain Audio의 개발자 Metehan Sipahi는 지나치게 깔끔해지는 현대 음향 툴에 반하여 4화음 제한과 작은 스피커의 찌그러짐을 의도적으로 구현한 레트로 샘플러 2G를 선보였습니다. 커뮤니티는 2000년대 초반 배터리 2% 남은 피처폰에서 흘러나오는 듯한 감성적 노스탤지어 사운드에 열광하며 신선한 역발상이라 호평했습니다. 특히 단순 일회성 사운드 생성을 넘어 사용자의 자체 오디오를 불러와 2G만의 독창적인 레트로 질감으로 착색할 수 있다는 확장성에 높은 평가를 내렸습니다.
products.warnings: 의도적인 4화음(4-voice) 제한과 로우파이 음향 압축이 적용되어 있으므로 풀 레인지의 깨끗한 고음질 음악 작업보다는 빈티지 로우파이 특화 사운드 디자인 및 샘플링에 적합합니다.

comments.author: Metehan Sipahi
comments.text:
Hi PH, we’re Scrap Brain Audio. We’re mostly curious whether the idea behind 2G holds up.

Most music software keeps getting cleaner and more capable. We went the other way on purpose: a low sample rate, a speaker that compresses and rings, only four voices. Would you want limits like that in the tools you use, or do they get in the way once the novelty wears off?

Upvote

안녕하세요 PH, 저희는 Scrap Brain Audio입니다. 2G에 담긴 아이디어가 여러분께 어떻게 다가갈지 정말 궁금합니다.

대부분의 음악 소프트웨어는 점점 더 깨끗해지고 고성능화되고 있습니다. 저희는 의도적으로 정반대의 길을 택했습니다. 낮은 샘플 레이트, 컴프레션이 걸려 찌그러지고 울리는 스피커, 단 4개의 보이스 제한입니다. 여러분이 사용하는 작업 도구에 이러한 제약이 있는 것을 선호하시나요, 아니면 신선함이 사라지고 나면 작업에 방해가 될까요?
